style.styleTitle: Hallmark Harry Potter Marauder Map Mug Christmas Bauble
style.toneOfVoice: Enchant their world and make any occasion spellbinding with this wonderful Harry Potter Marauder s Map Mug Keepsake hanging ornament. Display it on your Christmas tree or as part of your Harry Potter collection all year round. Made from hard-wearing resin, this detailed ornament features the Marauder s Map from Harry Potter in a mug-shaped design. The mug includes a functional opening lid with a Golden Snitch hinge, press the Snitch to reveal the lid opening. Simply add a loop of twine, ribbon or thread (not included) to the metal ring to hang and display this collectible keepsake in your home. Message on the decoration reads: I solemnly swear that I am up to no good. It s the perfect Christmas tree decoration or gift for Harry Potter fans. Hallmark Ornaments are a great way to commemorate hobbies, life events and individual interests in movies, games and more. Ornament Measures: H9.3cm by W5.8cm by D4.2cm. This is not a toy. For decorative use only. Dimensions(mm): Height: 93 Width: 58 Depth: 42
